claim: The chapter teaches 牛 (うし), 赤 (あか), 青 (あお) and 天 (てん) as words with one reading each, but all four ship only as silent character cards from earlier units, while 昔 and 色, taught the same way, are voiced word cards.
evidence: Book, kanji table: "牛(うし) cow", "赤(あか) red color", "青(あお) blue color"; reading vocabulary: "天（てん） the heavens; the sky", "牛 cow". Cards: chapter-9 r-bf9b3e9c32c4 牛 "Cow" (gyū / ushi, no audio); chapter-10 r-72776ab68f81 赤 "Red" (seki / aka) and r-845d1da87f89 青 "Blue" (sei / ao), no audio; chapter-5 r-c3304d1e49e3 天 "Heaven" (ten / ame, ama, no audio). This unit's as-generated.json had 牛 "Cow" (うし), 赤 "Red color" (あか) and 青 "Blue color" (あお) as voiced words under those same ids. chapter-25 r-cccfb185278a 昔 (mukashi) and chapter-10 r-1391f4a4c627 色 (iro) carry audio.
fix: Make 牛, 赤, 青 and 天 voiced word cards with the book's readings (うし, あか, あお, てん) and English ("Cow", "Red (color)", "Blue (color)", "The heavens; the sky"), as the language rules ask for a kanji the book also teaches as a word.

claim: This chapter teaches the kanji 度 as "time; degrees", but the one 度 card in the deck answers only "Degrees (temperature)", so the "time" sense it uses in 一度 and 今度 is carded nowhere.
evidence: Book, kanji 142: "度 (time; degrees) ▶ど 一度(いちど) once 今度(こんど) near future 温度 ... 三十度 ... 態度". reading-report.json drops 度 here as "already carded in Chapter 10: Lesson 8". Card chapter-9 r-304fce687a69: 度 "Degrees (temperature)" (do, voiced).
fix: Change the English to carry both senses, e.g. "Time (occurrence); degrees".
